item.title: 'I think it's probably going to cause a bit of trouble later in the year'
item.description: Brian Ó Beaglaoich has expressed concerns over the GAA's hooter system.

item.title: Quarter-final day in Sigerson and Fitzgibbon Cups
item.description: The Sigerson and Fitzgibbon Cup quarter-finals take place today.

item.title: Offaly outlaws joint-captains
item.description: Offaly GAA has put a stop to teams having joint-captains.

item.title: Small happy with retirement decision
item.description: John Small has no regrets about hanging up his inter-county boots.

item.title: UCC, UL, Queen's and University of Galway advance to Sigerson Cup semis
item.description: The Sigerson Cup is down to its last four teams following the conclusion of its quarter-final stage last night (Wednesday).

item.title: UL to meet University of Galway in Fitzgibbon Cup semi-finals
item.description: UL are through to the semi-finals of the Fitzgibbon Cup thanks to a 0-20 to 0-12 win against UCC at the UL Grounds last night (Wednesday).

item.title: Louth v Cork switched from Ardee to Drogheda
item.description: Sunday's Allianz Football League Division 2 second round clash between Louth and Cork has been moved from Ardee to Drogheda.

item.title: "It's always a huge test going to the Hyde" - Bannigan
item.description: Monaghan boss Gabriel Bannigan says his side are expecting "a huge test" this weekend as they travel to take on Roscommon in the second round of the Allianz Football League.

item.title: Watch: Meath star Morris nails sensational two-pointer for TUD in Sigerson Cup
item.description: Meath ace Jordan Morris showcased his kicking capability again last night in the quarter-finals of the Sigerson Cup.

item.title: "It's not an easy job that Ger has"
item.description: Former Westmeath star Dessie Dolan feels that Ger Brennan "has a job on his hands" to bring through Dublin's next batch of players that can deliver success.
